checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same red hatchback in every version
must.why: The first image repaints the car blue. The other two keep the red car.
The whole car is visible in all three.
The blue version changes the car's color. The shapes are preserved.

must.item: Padding is blurred source, no added text
must.why: No padding and no added text.

faults.what: The request was for ratio variants (1:1, 4:5, 9:16). The agent made scene and color restyles at the original landscape ratio instead.
The car was repainted blue in one version, so it is no longer the same red car.
The snow version has odd snow-covered artefacts on the car and ground.

summary: The agent delivered three good-looking restyled images (blue car, snowy night, sunset), but none has a 1:1, 4:5 or 9:16 ratio, and one changes the car's color.
